description: This file is a shell script that provides a comprehensive test suite for Git's mailmap functionality, testing various scenarios including configuration, mapping rules, file locations, symlinks, boundary cases, and output formats.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the test repository with specified parameters.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets git configuration for the test.

methods.name: test_file_not_empty
methods.description: Checks that a file is not empty.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within a file or output.

methods.name: test_git
methods.description: Executes a git command within the test context.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
